outcome: time from uterine fibroid embolization to pregnancy
cohort: 181 non-menopausal patients who had symptomatic uterine fibroids for which they had benefited from embolization of the uterine arteries in Côte d'Ivoire from February 2012 to February 2018
finding: Of the 65 patients who underwent uterine fibroid embolization, eleven (16.9%) conceived, with a mean time from embolization to pregnancy of 34 months.
